This means Salesforce will not participate in the `CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT`-based flow and will perform a refresh + DB write whenever this code path runs, which is a meaningful inconsistency/perf/architecture concern introduced by the change, though not necessarily a correctness break by itself.
